title: Gina NDE 2143
content: On both occasions a being of white light appeared to me, took my hand, and took me to a door that opened on its own. As a child, I remember I had to climb three steps to arrive at the door and in the last experience I didn't see any door. I went directly to the place of light where you don't step or walk - you float. In the second more recent experience, I remember first seeing a dim tunnel where I saw various deceased people I knew, one of whom touched my feet. I left those people behind in order to ascend accompanied by the being of light and go to the place where one floats. I did not see anyone there but I felt caresses on my head. I also remember that my family members were in the hospital room crying and I, despairing at seeing them suffer, wanted to return rapidly. I remember on both occasions that the voices of the doctors and nurses resounded in my head, and while I was ascending, the voices faded back but I continued hearing them. (I don't know how to explain this. It's as if you were a million kilometers away but you took a carried microphone in order to hear). In the second experience I remember seeing my husband all upset and praying that I would not die. I also remember a place where there were objects, people who looked like angels, animals and plants. The strange thing about all this was that EVERYTHING had life and eyes. I also saw beings dressed in black capes who, when they saw the being who was holding my hand, bowed their heads - as though they could not look at his face - or perhaps out of respect. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1975 & 2004 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Accident Surgery-related Direct head injury Life threatening event, but not clinical death Accidente at 4 years old. Una caida de 4 mentros de altura A los 33 años accidente con riesgo de perder la vida. How do you consider the content of your experience? Frightening Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Upon awakening. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster than usual Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Vision. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes In the second experience I remember first passing through a place of little light where there were many deceased beings known to me. Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I don't remember communicating with them, but I do remember that a being known to me touched my feet. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes A very white light. The place was very white. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place Si. Era como salir del cuerpo y viajar hacia arriba. Primero ves oscuridad y cada vez ves mas claridad al subir. El lugar donde me vi era enorme y los seres flotaban. What emotions did you feel during the experience? When I remember the childhood experience my emotions are clearly of fear and anguish. In the second experience I felt much love, much peace and much happiness. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Liberal Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I had the sensation that I had to pass through this experience in order to remember the way toward the light and help the beings who have already died and are lost in the place of little light. Sincerely, I don't know why because even today I don't understand how I can do it, but this is something that stays etched in my mind. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Clairvoyance, intuition, and dreams that are premonitions. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The whole experience was significant because since then I have not be able to get this experience out of my mind. My life has changed completely since then. Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real The experience was definitely real. It is an experience that if I were to tell you about would seem a fantasy. But whoever goes through a similar experience knows that it is real, and returning to this life and remembering, makes this earthly life even more difficult to live. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Do you see yourself as the same body during this experience? Do you see in color or in black and white?

tunnel.passage_other_detail: In the second experience she recalls first seeing “a dim tunnel” / “a place of little light where there were many deceased beings known to me.”

arrival.other_being_detail: “beings dressed in black capes” who bowed their heads when they saw the being of light holding her hand.

environment.environment_other_detail: She describes “a place where there were objects, people who looked like angels, animals and plants,” and that “EVERYTHING had life and eyes.” She also describes “the place was very white” and “the beings floated.”

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She felt she “had to pass through this experience in order to remember the way toward the light and help the beings who have already died and are lost in the place of little light.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: At age 4: fall from about 4 meters. At age 33: accident with risk of losing her life.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Door/threshold imagery (“a door that opened on its own,” with “three steps” in childhood); auditory carryover of hospital voices while ascending; caresses felt on her head; beings in black capes bowing to the being of light; “EVERYTHING had life and eyes.”
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Two NDEs. In the second: dim tunnel with deceased people → she leaves them behind and ascends with a being of white light → arrives at a white floating realm; in the first: being of white light leads her by the hand to a door (three steps) that opens by itself.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Being of white light present in both experiences; ascent toward a place of light in both.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Auditory perception of doctors’/nurses’ voices continuing while “ascending,” described like hearing via “a carried microphone” from very far away; a realm where “EVERYTHING had life and eyes”; beings in black capes bowing to the being of light; tactile sensations (feet touched by a deceased person; caresses on her head).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I went directly to the place of light where you don't step or walk - you float.” / “In the second more recent experience, I remember first seeing a dim tunnel where I saw various deceased people I knew, one of whom touched my feet.” / “The strange thing about all this was that EVERYTHING had life and eyes.”
